name: Dumbbell Z Press
cues: Sit on the floor with legs straight, dumbbells at shoulder height
Press up until your arms are straight overhead
Lower with control to shoulder height

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). The press reuses the 202 path and bottoms at ear level (elbow max 110). The 235 cues say 'dumbbells at shoulder height' and 'Lower with control to shoulder height', while 202's cue says 'about ear level'. Cue and motion disagree.
